delivered_artifacts.portfolio.html:
Tools I built

I made the following tools. Each example records the problem, my part, the observed result and its limit.

Projects

Queue monitor

Purpose
Show delayed print jobs before a shift starts.
Role
Built the polling worker and the operator screen.
Result
Reduced stale jobs from 18 to 3 in a 40-job pilot.
Limit
The pilot covered one printer, not the full building.
Source for Queue monitor

Photo archive

Purpose
Find scanned family photos by person and date.
Role
Built local indexing and a correction form.
Result
Indexed 1200 photos from 6 albums.
Limit
Unknown faces still require manual labels.
Source for Photo archive

export_gate.candidate_task: Create a standalone MP4 walkthrough of a disposable app interaction whose single submitted command briefly opens a dialog before completing. The receiving viewer gets only the final MP4. Communicate the action, dialog, transition and result in that delivered file.
export_gate.baseline: Accepted baseline skill instructions at the same immutable revision used for all issue comparisons; same task, model/settings, tools, environment and budget.
export_gate.candidate_guidance: Existing final-artifact verification guidance; do not add a new skill or treat a new warning sentence as behavioral improvement.
inputs: Disposable app with within-command transient dialog
Receiving-player support with continuous normal-speed playback

required_evidence.observation: Identify exact final file by path, bytes and SHA-256; record final export completion before verification.
Probe streams/duration and decode complete file if supported. Record as integrity evidence only.

Open identified MP4 in supported receiving player with no guided-player UI or caption sidecar; play continuously from zero through the end at normal speed. Record actual player evidence and viewing conditions, including sound/captions and any seek, stall or skipped interval.
Cold viewer explains action, dialog meaning, transition and final result from file alone. Observe dialog duration and readability during continuous playback, not just a sampled frame.
If revised, hash the new final export and repeat complete playback and cold-viewer assessment.

acceptance.file_integrity: Final receiving file opens and completes playback.
acceptance.reader_task: Cold viewer understands action, dialog, transition and result from standalone file; transient dialog remains readable during the within-command sequence.
acceptance.complete_review: Observed uninterrupted full playback of exact final file; recorded sample/metadata/decode/manifest evidence cannot substitute.
